name: [TV] Samsung 6 Series (65)
capabilities_text: list, open and close installed apps over the network
remote keys and typing over the network, after choosing Allow once on the TV

notes.text: Not Android: no developer mode, so no debloat, app installs, launcher or screenshots. For the full workflow, add an Android / Google TV streaming stick on HDMI.
Pair once (tvctl pair, or PAIR REMOTE in the control center) and choose Allow on the TV to send keys and open apps.
